in_sanskrit.name: Balamani
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Powerful Goddess
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Balamani एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Balamani is a combination of two Sanskrit words: 'Bal' meaning strength and 'Mani' meaning jewel or goddess. This name signifies a powerful and divine woman. In Hindu mythology, Balamani is believed to be an incarnation of the goddess Durga, symbolizing strength, courage, and wisdom.

This name signifies a powerful and divine woman. In Hindu mythology, Balamani is believed to be an incarnation of the goddess Durga, symbolizing strength, courage, and wisdom.
